comment: Single unified Deals pipeline (Zoho default). Sector = Line of business on Lead/Deal (Production | MPS | Radiology). Stage labels must match Deals → Stage picklist exactly. Sync: ./venv/bin/python provision_pipelines.py --sync

pipelines.intent: Unified motion for all sectors; filter by Line of business in CRM views and Power BI.
pipelines.notes: 7 deal stages (2026-04): dropped Identify Decision Makers (same work lives under Value Proposition) and Closed Lost to Competition (use Closed Lost + Competitor / Lost Reason). Legacy picklist values may remain in org for old records — move deals then deactivate unused options in Setup if desired.
